During the time of this ancient empire, runelords commonly carved their faces into the mountainsides that faced their capital cities. The carving of Xin, however, faces the Runeforge, a place of great importance shared by all of the runelords.⁠

At the mountain's western base, just off the lake, lies a ring of seven ten-foot-tall, open-mouthed stone heads angled toward each other known as the Sihedron Circle. This Thassilonian ruin was recently discovered to be a magical entrance to the Runeforge.⁠

Canalsguard

Canalsguard is a castle located next to Pastorling at the conjunction of the Lingian Prefecture's three largest canals. It was originally built to protect Taldor's canals from being used by any invading force from Qadira.

Canalsguard was originally built as a inspection and toll station, but during the Grand Campaign it was greatly expanded and heavily fortified. Since the end of the war with Qadira, Canalsguard has lingered as a hopelessly overbuilt relic of the war.

As of 4717 AR, it was guarded by a skeleton garrison barely large enough to manage the toll station. Most of the fortress is unused, except as a dumping ground by the Taldan military for washouts and screw-ups. Canalsguard's commander as of 4717 AR was Urbicus Porphygo, scion of middling House Porphygo in Oppara, and even with by Canalsguard's low standards he has not been a stellar commander of the fortress.⁠

Castle Belverio

Castle Belverio is part of the northern wall of the Chelaxian city of Corentyn. The castle is partially ruined, although it has been rebuilt several times.⁠

The Castle Belverio is one of the nine famous forts of Corentyn, the City of Nine Forts, according to the classical listing.⁠
2032723675:
Vinpinna

Vinpinna is a town in the foothills of the Pardaparbat Mountains in the Impossible Kingdoms of Vudra. Located in the south-western reaches of the Narhari Desert region, the nearby towns of Vinpinna and Adhaarm are each controlled by an order of undead martial artists.⁠⁠
2042687215:
Fort Longjaw

Fort Longjaw is located northeast of Solku, near the Brazen Peaks. It is a wooden stockade that stands as a symbol against kholo aggression. Its proud red flag displays a bleached white jawbone divided by a silver sword. The fort's residents are desert warriors who dedicate themselves to driving back kholo raiding parties, destroying kholo settlements wherever they lurk, and hunting down any other desert dangers such as hyenas. Led by Giana Secondstride, every day they scout the area for miles, hunting for slaver tracks, setting up false caravans to act as decoys, and interrogating travelers about any signs of kholo activity.⁠⁠
2043813315:
Khari

Khari is the southernmost settlement of Cheliax, lying at the southern end of the Arch of Aroden and the Hespereth Strait that it once spanned. Since the independence of Sargava, Khari is the only Chelaxian city left on the continent of Garund.⁠⁠ Formerly a Rahadoumi city, Khari is the largest settlement in the province of Kharijite in the Archduchy of Longmarch.⁠⁠
2045442855:
Enganoka

Enganoka is the capital of Hosekikozan Province located on the western coast of Minkai⁠ and a significant port for trade. It is particularly well known for the luxury goods—especially dyes, gemstones, and silk⁠—that it trades out of its Kuroi Yane market.⁠
2050103055:
Erspurn

Little is known about Erspurn, a settlement of western Osirion during its First Age located in what is now Rahadoum.⁠⁠
2066369975:
Cayden's Keg

Cayden's Keg is a popular tavern in the Isgeri town of Breachill where Cayden Cailean's followers and locals alike can enjoy a drink. Owner and priest Brynne Taithe is a big fan of adventure stories and encourages visitors to share them. If the audience enjoys the stories, she often buys them a round, which encourages more people to drink and have a good time.⁠
2070458315:
Fusil

Fusil is a town in far-eastern Andoran surrounded on all sides by the Verduran Forest. Ages ago, the inhabitants of the hamlet made a pact with the local druids and fey-folk. In exchange for the location of a rich gem mine, the citizens of Fusil pledged that no one would chop down a single tree of the forest. The terms of the agreement have not been breached, and the inhabitants make a decent living from the mine, use only stone in the construction of their homes, and rely on peat fires for warmth.⁠⁠
2072532115:
Alkenstar City

Alkenstar City is the capital city of the Grand Duchy of Alkenstar and houses the whole of the Duchy's governmental infrastructure. The city is located on top of the Hellfallen Cliffs, where the Ustradi River falls seven hundred feet down Alken Falls. Monumental works of engineering and architecture, including the Bridge of the Gods, connect the city to the vassal communities of Martel and Dongun Hold. As a result of the urban development of the Duchy, many incorrectly consider these vassals mere districts of Alkenstar City proper, rather than distinct communities in their own right.

Alkenstar City is also the nation's center of industry, housing the Duchy's infamous Gunworks, the source of mass-produced firearms used both for the protection of the city-state and for trade throughout the Inner Sea region. As a result of the industrial advancement of Alkenstar, a constant cloud of white steam and sooty smoke hangs in a haze over the city, generated by the gears and pistons of countless factories operating around the clock.⁠

To the west of the city are the Karggat Hills, a rocky region dotted with mines and factories.⁠

2100658155:
Desert's Mouth

Desert's Mouth is a black pit at the bottom of a conical hole in the shifting sand dunes of the Osirian Desert near the Thuvian border. It resembles the lair of a giant ant lion and its circular hole is a strangely regular entrance into a huge cavern which is probably connected to the Darklands. Phosphorescent gases drift out of the pit at night and those who stay too near the pit report hallucinations about dark caves dripping with water. Descending the sandy slopes is difficult but ascending is almost impossible. The Desert's Mouth hasn't been explored in recent memory but ancient texts describe forests of glowing fungus and strange crustaceans skittering in the dark.⁠

The Yerbira are said to use the Mouth to execute those who breach their few taboos. They lower the condemned into the pit with a rope and throw the rope after him. If the condemned can climb out the pit he is considered forgiven. No one has ever climbed out the pit so far.⁠

Vespam Artisans

As of 4724 AR, Vespam Artisans is one of the larger businesses still in the Old Kintargo district of Kintargo.⁠ It serves as both a metalworking workshop and tinkers' guild. Vespam Artisans is owned and operated by Vespasio Vespam,⁠⁠⁠ a fifth-generation Kintargan⁠ and lifelong resident of Old Kintargo.⁠
2124869505:
Acorn's Rest

Acorn's Rest is a small village located in the portion of the Fangwood south of the Marideth River in Nirmathas. Most of its residents are druids attempting to maintain the forest during the nation's war with Molthune.⁠⁠

The druids of Acorn's Rest are friendly and open to visitors who respect the Fangwood.⁠
2125398155:
Ghorvaul's Crossing

Ghorvaul's Crossing is a small pass through the Mindspin Mountains into Molthune and is guarded by the colossus Speakers of the Ehrotai.⁠
2126606335:
Cyremium

Cyremium is a small, isolated fishing town on the Inner Sea coast, just east of the southern tip of the Cape of Hope on the Missa Shelf. Now located within the Arthfell region of Andoran, the town once was the site of a Taldan fortress that was abandoned soon after the end of the Even-Tongued Conquest of 4081 AR. Local settlers began dismantling the four watchtowers to build their homes as soon as the soldiers left, although the outer, sun-bleached walls still remain.⁠⁠⁠
2135656055:
Dead Slave Cove

Dead Slave Cove is a barren beach of Raptor Island, one of the westernmost islands of the Shackles, located near the mouth of the island's main river of Broken Hope. Sailors use the wild island to maroon troublesome enemies captured in battle as well as malcontents and traitors. Most castaways deposited on Dead Slave Cove are destined to spend the rest of their lives on Raptor Island. The rocky shores and the jagged reefs prevent ships from approaching Raptor Island, so a ship must anchor about a quarter-mile offshore and use a longboat to reach Dead Slave Cove.⁠

Deverin Villa is the main residence of House Deverin, an aristocratic family in the Varisian city of Magnimar. Located in the Naos district, Deverin Villa is currently occupied by Hobart Deverin, the head of the family. A walled compound with a central main building and several secondary structures, Deverin Villa is sandwiched between Kaijitsu Manor and the House of Welcome, Magnimar's most exclusive brothel.⁠

Long Roads Coffeehouse

The Long Roads Coffeehouse is one of numerous small restaurants, eateries, and coffee houses scattered across the Villegre district of Kintargo in Cheliax. It is located north of Villegre Park.⁠⁠

Its owner, Laria Longroad, has a dedicated if eclectic clientele: a mixture of wide-eyed students from the Alabaster Academy and other educational institutions alongside noble patrons from the neighbouring Greens district.⁠

The Long Roads Coffeehouse's success is partially due to the quality of its drinks and food, including traditional halfling cuisine, but under Chelaxian rule it also served as a front for Laria's connections with the then-illegal Bellflower Network and seemingly every other rogue and revolutionary in the city.⁠

She kept the Coffeehouse's role in these activities secret until they were exposed to the Scarlet Triad by Hundy Vosht in 4719 AR.⁠ The criminal organization briefly captured Longroad in a raid against her coffeehouse that killed several of its patrons,⁠ an act that quickly engaged her in efforts to rout the Triad from Kintargo.⁠ Its role in the Rebellion has since made it as much a tourist attraction as a cafe.⁠
2138693115:
Mistress of Angels

The Mistress of Angels is a fine marble sculpture located in Magnimar's southern Ordellia district. It depicts Ordellia Whilwren, one of Magnimar's founders, scanning the horizon of the Varisian Gulf, seemingly looking out for danger. Whilwren was a cleric of Desna and one of Alcaydian Indros' colleagues at the founding of the city,⁠⁠ and the statue is an occasional gathering place for Magnimarian Mystery Cultists.⁠
